text: Adopt compositional relational analysis rather than a Workflow class hierarchy. Trials uses K for all pairing dimensions and opaque M for annotations. Relation is a sealed inspectable ADT so execution can hash join, plans can serialize named projections, and diagnostics can explain exclusions. PairDesign makes invalid self, orientation, and sampling combinations unrepresentable; canonical undirected evaluation requires SymmetricCompare. PairwiseAnalysis retains both keys and reduction orientation is explicit. Directed control sampling is keyed bottom-k over Seed, SampleId, focal digest, and candidate digest, excluding cap to preserve monotonicity. KeyDigest derives through Mirror and is Eq-consistent across JVM and Scala.js. Surface decomposition preserves Mass, Intensity, and Signed distinctions, treats NNLS contributions as mixture weights only under a simplex constraint, and ships descriptive rather than invalid cell-wise inferential statistics. Participant scope is mandatory in repetition designs, and eyesim repetitive similarity is a documented divergence fixture because its vignette and implementation disagree. PRD C-9, X-1 through X-17, DET-4, V-4, V-7, and V-9 are normative.
